content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a few adjustments before signing:
- The termination clause currently allows the client to end the agreement at any time without notice or payment for work already done. I propose that either party may terminate for material breach with 15 days’ written notice, and that upon termination the client shall pay for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the termination date.
- The intellectual property clause transfers ownership of each deliverable to the client upon delivery, even if payment is pending. I suggest that all intellectual property rights in each deliverable shall transfer to the client only after full payment of the corresponding invoice.

Please let me know if these revisions are acceptable. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
